y-m-39-01.topic: Mamiriro ekushandisa sum rule: kutarisa kana nyaya mbiri dzichifukidzana
y-m-39-01.goal: Usati wabatanidza huwandu hwemamiriro maviri akabatanidzwa ne "kana," tsvaga kana nyaya mbiri dzichifukidzana, tsvaga iwe pachako nhamba dzinofukidzana, uye utaure huwandu hwakarurama.
y-m-39-01.material: Nyaya iyi inoverenga kuti nhamba dzechisikigo kubva ku1 kusvika ku50 dzingani ndema multiples e4 kana ema multiples e6. Nhamba iri multiple e4 uye multiple e6 zvose inosangana ne "kana," uye nhamba yakadaro inoverengwa kamwe chete. Pazasi pane mhinduro yemudzidzi mumwe.

y-m-39-01.thinking.1: Tarisa nekugadzira muenzaniso unofukidzana iwe pachako
y-m-39-01.thinking.2: Tonga mamiriro anofanira kuvapo kuti ushandise mhinduro, kunyangwe mhinduro yakafanana

y-m-39-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe mumhinduro une kufunga kusingashande. (Nhamba dzemitsara dzinotanga pamutsara 1.)
y-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora chaizvo nhamba dziri mumitsara 1 ne2 seronda, wozoenzanisa nemaziso kana nhamba imwe chete iri mumarondedzero ose.
y-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana chikonzero chakapiwa mumutsara we3 (mamiriro akasiyana) chinovimbisa chokwadi che "hapana nhamba inoenderana mumarondedzero maviri."
y-m-39-01.s.s1.line.0: Ma multiples e4 ndi4, 8, ..., 48, ndiko kuti nhamba 12.
y-m-39-01.s.s1.line.1: Ma multiples e6 ndi6, 12, ..., 48, ndiko kuti nhamba 8.
y-m-39-01.s.s1.line.2: "Iri multiple e4" ne "iri multiple e6" mamiriro akasiyana, saka kuverenga kuviri kunogona kuwedzerwa sezvakaita.
y-m-39-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 ndiwo dambudziko. Kuti mamiriro ane mazita akasiyana hakureve kuti nyaya mbiri hadziiti panguva imwe chete. 12 ndi multiple e4 uye multiple e6 zvose, saka iri mumarondedzero ose, uye kuwedzera sezvakaita kunoiverenga kaviri. Saka 20 yemutsara we4 haisirewo yakarurama. 12 ne8 dzemitsara 1 ne2 dzakarurama.

y-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.0: Murondedzero yema multiples e4, ratidza imwe neimwe nhamba dzinoparadzaniswa ne6.
y-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.1: Cherechedza mikaha pakati penhamba dzawakawana, uye utarise kuti mukaha uyu une hukama sei nenhamba mbiri 4 ne6.

y-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Inofanira kuva nhamba yechisikigo kubva ku1 kusvika ku50.
y-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Haisi multiple e4. Tarisa kana inoparadzaniswa ne4.
y-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Haisi multiple e6. Tarisa kana inoparadzaniswa ne6.
y-m-39-01.s.s2.explain: 12, 24, 36, 48 dzose dziri mumarondedzero ose. Nhamba idzi dziri mu12 ma multiples e4 uye zvakare mu8 ma multiples e6, saka dzakaverengwa kaviri mu sum 20.
y-m-39-01.s.s3.prompt: Wakatarisa nhamba dzinofukidzana. Huwandu hwakarurama hwenhamba dziri ma multiples e4 kana ma multiples e6 ndehupi?
y-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora ma multiples ose e4 ne6 murondedzero imwe, ratidza nhamba imwe chete kamwe chete, uye uverenge.
y-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kuti nhamba dzakasiyana dzose dzawakangowana mu s2 dzingani, uye kuti imwe neimwe yadzo yakaverengwa kangani mu 12 + 8.
y-m-39-01.s.s3.r.a: Wakaverenga iwe pachako nhamba dzinofukidzana uye wakagadzirisa kuti imwe neimwe iverengwe kamwe chete.
y-m-39-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakawedzera huwandu hwaviri sezvakaita usina kutarisa kana nhamba dzinofukidzana dzingaverengwa kaviri.
y-m-39-01.s.s3.r.c: Wakawedzera nhamba dzinofukidzana kamwe chete zvakare panzvimbo pekudzibvisa. Kana pane kufukidzana, unofanira kufunga nenzira yekudzikisa.
y-m-39-01.s.s3.r.d: Wakanyepa nhamba dzinofukidzana se2. Verenga nhamba dzose dzawakawana kare.
y-m-39-01.s.s3.explain: Pakati pema multiples e4 12 nema multiples e6 8, nhamba 4 dzakasiyana 12, 24, 36, 48 dziri mumarondedzero ose dzakaverengwa kaviri, saka huwandu henhamba dzakasiyana ndi12 + 8 - 4 = 16. Kubatanidza marondedzero maviri uye kuverenga nhamba dzakasiyana zvakananga kunopawo 16.

y-m-39-04.title: Painonyanya kusarudzwa vanhu, huwandu hwenzira hunokuramowo here?
y-m-39-04.topic: Chimiro chekuti huwandu hwema combinations hunochinja sei, ne counterexample
y-m-39-04.goal: Usatenderwe nemienzaniso mishoma yechirevo chekuti "kana huwandu hwevanhu vanosarudzwa hukura, huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza hunokurawo," asi gadzira iwe pachako counterexample kuratidza kuti hazvishande.
y-m-39-04.material: Verenga huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza r vanhu (0 ≤ r ≤ 8, integer) kubva pa 8 candidates usingafungi kurongeka. Huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza r vanhu pa 8 hunonyorwa 8Cr (inoverengwa: eight C r). Mudzidzi mumwe akati, "Kana huwandu hwevanhu vanosarudzwa, r, hukura, huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza hunogara hwuchikuramowo."

y-m-39-04.thinking.1: Gadzira iwe pachako counterexample uye utarise
y-m-39-04.thinking.2: Tsanangura chikonzero kuburikidza nehukama pakati pekusarudza nekusiya
y-m-39-04.prereq.1: Zvinoreva combinations (huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza r pa n usingafungi kurongeka) uye maitiro ekuwana mutengo we nCr
y-m-39-04.prereq.2: Tsika yekuti nC0 = 1 pa integer r i 0 kana kupfuura
y-m-39-04.s.s1.prompt: 8C1 = 8, 8C2 = 28, 8C3 = 56. Unogona kutarisa sei chirevo chiri pamusoro kubva pamitengo iyi oga?
y-m-39-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kuenda ku r = 4, 5, ..., verenga iwe pachako 8Cr uye unyore tebhura.
y-m-39-04.s.s1.hint.1: Funga hukama pakati pekusarudza r pa vanhu 8 nehuwandu hwevanhu vasina kusarudzwa vasara.
y-m-39-04.s.s1.o.a: Yakakura kusvika ku r = 3, saka inogona kuramba ichikura kusvika ku r = 8, uye hapana chikonzero chekutarisa zvakare
y-m-39-04.s.s1.r.a: Wakapedza nezvemitengo yakatevera kubva pamishoma yekutanga. Unofanira kutarisa zvakare kana mitengo inoramba ichichinja nemutemo mumwechete.
y-m-39-04.s.s1.o.b: Kutarisa kusvika ku r = 3 oga hakutiudze kana inoramba ichikura mushure meizvozvo, saka tinofanira kutarisa zvakawanda
y-m-39-04.s.s1.r.b: Yakaratidza kuti range yakatarisirwa nerange yechirevo zvakasiyana.
y-m-39-04.s.s1.o.c: Yakakura kusvika ku r = 3, saka chirevo chinogona kutorwa sechakaipa
y-m-39-04.s.s1.r.c: Mitengo yakapiwa inoenderana nechirevo. Haugone kutaura kuti chakaipa nekuda kwayo.
y-m-39-04.s.s1.o.d: Yaiva yakarurama pa r = 1, 2, 3, saka chirevo charatidzwa
y-m-39-04.s.s1.r.d: Mienzaniso mishoma ichiva yakarurama hakuiti humbowo.
y-m-39-04.s.s1.explain: Kuti mitengo mitatu yakakura i mienzaniso isingapokani nechirevo chete. Zvinoitika kana r ichikura zvinofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana.
y-m-39-04.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso 2 yakasiyana isingaenderani nechirevo (counterexamples). I ma integers p < q (0 ≤ p, q ≤ 8), uye huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza vanhu p, 8Cp, hunofanira kuva hukuru kupfuura huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza vanhu q, 8Cq.
y-m-39-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora 8C0 kusvika 8C8 mumutsetse mumwe uye utarise kwakura kupi mitengo uye kwadzikira kupi.
y-m-39-04.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga mutebhura mapeya ane mitengo yakaenzana (semuenzaniso, r nenhamba imwe) uye ufunge kana peya yakadaro ichikubatsira kugadzira counterexample.
y-m-39-04.s.s2.ok.c1: p ne q i ma integers kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 8.
y-m-39-04.s.s2.fail.c1: p ne q dzinofanira kuva ma integers kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 8.
y-m-39-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza vanhu p hahuzi hukuru kupfuura huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza vanhu q. Verenga iwe pachako mitengo miviri uye uienzanise.
y-m-39-04.s.s2.explain: 8C0 kusvika 8C8 i 1, 8, 28, 56, 70, 56, 28, 8, 1. Semuenzaniso, kana p = 4, q = 5, saka 70 > 56, uye kana p = 2, q = 7, saka 28 > 8. Nenzira iyi, mushure mekupfuura pakati, mitengo inodzikira zvakare.
y-m-39-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza peya imwe, nyora kuti huwandu hwenzira mbiri hwakadini chaizvo, uye utsanangure kuti sei izvi zvichiitika.

y-m-39-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Wana peya ine mitengo yakaenzana mutebhura uye uienzanise.
